title: Runtime session event (protocol 1)
description: One telemetry event as Unity emits it in the Events bridge message and as Mobile sends it unchanged in POST /api/training/sessions/{id}/events:batch (or /api/playtests/{id}/events:batch). Same shape as the BE TrainingEvent DTO. Core events carry the metric payloads below; any other type must be declared by the pinned runtime catalog (capabilityContracts[*].events), otherwise BE answers it in conflicts (EVENT_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED / EVENT_PAYLOAD_INVALID) and it must not be resent.

eventId.description: GUID, unique per event; a resend keeps the same eventId and content.

sequence.description: 1, 2, 3, ... without gaps; after a resume it continues after resumeFromSequence.

objectId.description: Id of the Goal object in fet3d.editor/1.

amount.description: Simulated exposure integrated over the last interval (not a medical value).
